name: Moving bed biofilm reactor (MBBR/IFAS)
principle: Follows the Veolia/AnoxKaldnes licensor flow: protected biofilm grows on free-floating polyethylene carrier elements (K1/K3) kept moving by aeration or mixing; retention screens keep carriers in each basin; IFAS retrofits add carriers to existing activated-sludge basins to boost capacity 50-100% without new tanks.

process_steps.name: Aerobic carrier zones
equipment: carrier retention screens at each partition

suppliers.name: Veolia
suppliers.product: AnoxKaldnes MBBR carriers and process licensor

gaps.reason: The IEA guide covers anaerobic digestion but not municipal wastewater process units; no agency TRL exists for most of them. Checked 2026-11-16.

costs.basis: Derived from a 5 m3/d all-in-one packaged unit at USD 20,800 (average 5, maximum 8 m3/d): screen, equalisation, anoxic tank, MBBR tank, central tube, chlorine contact, filtration and sludge holding; media and spares listed separately. Vendor quotes 2021, price year not stated. A small packaged unit has no economy of scale - do not read it as a municipal MBBR benchmark.
